animation: A stretched cloud leaves most cubes empty: from the Front view the camera turns to a raised three-quarter view, the dots lift into depth, the cells fade in as faint cubes, the empty ones dim to bare edges and a chip counts them, and the camera sweeps round the cube to the corner, one beat at a time.
highlight: the probe's entry (a large highlight disc with a ring, its spokes and its cube; chip "entry n of 64"); with the probe off the cloud, its error (chip "probe error 0.45, grid 0.0025"); with the Speech dots, the cloud's long axis (chip "most of the spread lies along this line: 21.3 dB")
